tasks.short: Measure water phenomena, capture contextual readings and produce checked graphs.

steps.what: Measure lake levels, stream flows and water volume changes
Record measurement values, station identifiers, units, timestamps and field conditions
Graph measurements using the selected units, time basis and station grouping
Check graph scales, unusual readings, gaps and measurement provenance

tasks.design: Use validated entry fields and native chart templates in {SPREADSHEET}. A deterministic graph step consumes the captured station, time and unit fields; field measurements and scientific checking remain human.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeated chart assembly and inconsistent field metadata.
tasks.enabler_now: Reusable chart specifications can render captured measurements consistently.
tasks.still_hard: Instrument suitability, rating relationships and interpreting anomalous readings.
tasks.human_edge: A hydrologist distinguishes real water changes from measurement artefacts.
tasks.altitude: Reduce chart assembly while preserving measurement quality.

reach.learn: Capture units and reference datums consistently

evidence.claim: Deterministic spreadsheet charts can reuse structured measurement fields; the proposed labour benefit is unmeasured.

assumptions: Includes field measurement, record entry, graph production and graph checking; no automated sensor installation is assumed.

Hydrologist produces station ID, reading, unit, timestamp, datum and condition flags in s2, with capture time counted; graph specification is selected and checked in s3-s4. Missing or mixed units stop graph production for manual correction.
Use existing chart templates first; do not count graph creation savings where charts are already automatic.
Graph generation is a draft, with no publication or control-system action implied.
unknowns: Current chart automation and station datum consistency
research_questions: How much present graph effort is manual chart assembly rather than data interpretation?

already_counted.description: Capture and verify graph input metadata

incremental.description: Maintain station chart templates and test changed data layouts

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=66, gross=34, upkeep=4, central net=30 E1. Low: mixed datums and irregular sampling require most charts to be assembled and reconciled manually, retaining 91 hours plus upkeep for 5 net. High: common station metadata permits chart reuse but unusual event plots retain extra formatting, retaining 76 hours plus upkeep for 20 net.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Research water conservation and communicate a checked, source-grounded account.

steps.what: Retrieve relevant water conservation studies and monitoring evidence
Design the conservation research and define appropriate comparisons
Conduct research and record supported findings, uncertainties and source references
Write conservation information from the documented findings

loop.input: Findings, uncertainties, citations and intended audience
loop.output: Draft with claims linked to supplied findings
loop.check: Hydrologist checks every number, reference, inference and uncertainty against the pack
loop.stop: One revision; any unresolved reference or inference returns the section to manual writing
loop.why_not_simpler: A fixed layout helps structure but cannot explain different research findings for each audience

steps.what: Check scientific conclusions, qualifications and conservation recommendations
Check and communicate the final water conservation information to the intended audience

tasks.design: Configure evidence retrieval in {DATA_PLATFORM} and use a native account template in {DOCS}. If prose drafting remains costly, a bounded loop drafts from the findings pack; scientific investigation, revision and final communication stay human.
tasks.previous_blocker: Evidence retrieval and explanatory writing compete with research time.
tasks.enabler_now: Source-linked drafts can reuse a carefully captured findings pack.
tasks.still_hard: Causal inference, local applicability and persuasive stakeholder engagement.
tasks.human_edge: The scientist explains limitations and defends conclusions.
tasks.altitude: Support communication without substituting prose generation for research.

reach.learn: Keep inference and source references connected

evidence.claim: Scopus AI supplies cited abstract summaries, with a warning against relying on them alone.
Generated literature reviews have contained fabricated citations, supporting direct source checking.
The proposed retrieval and drafting labour benefit is an unmeasured scenario.

assumptions: Research and communicating its results both remain within the task; no fieldwork savings are claimed.
Hydrologist produces claim, finding, unit, uncertainty and source reference in s3 with full capture effort retained. Missing support causes omission or manual investigation.
Native catalogue and document template first; no automatic research conclusion or publication.
s6 is the actual stakeholder presentation, separate from writing; exact final material is checked there.
unknowns: Evidence accessibility and audience-specific explanation needs
research_questions: Does drafting reduce total explanation writing and factual correction time?

incremental.description: Maintain drafting constraints and source-link checks

approvals.approved_version: Exact final account, numerical claims, qualifications and intended audience; changed material requires checking before communication.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=88, gross=12, upkeep=4, central net=8 E1. Low: site-specific findings have poor source metadata and explanations need extensive rewriting, retaining 95 hours plus upkeep for 1 net. High: comparable studies and traceable results support retrieval and partial prose reuse, retaining 91 hours plus upkeep for 5 net.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Develop and validate hydrologic prediction models using reusable input and configuration tools.

steps.what: Retrieve hydrologic observations, catchment layers and modelling requirements
Develop conceptual assumptions and select appropriate hydrologic model structure
Prepare computer model input tables and document units, datums and provenance
Develop model configuration, parameters and scenario definitions
Run the configured model for hydrologic predictions
Validate predictions, calibration, sensitivity and physical plausibility
Save the model configuration and validation record in the existing project

tasks.design: Use native input schemas and reusable scenario configurations in {OTHER}, the hydrologic modelling application, supported by {DATA_PLATFORM}. The scientist selects the physics and parameters, runs the existing model and validates results; ordinary project saving stays fully retained.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeated input preparation and configuration compete with conceptual model development.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing modelling tools can reuse validated input schemas and scenario definitions.
tasks.still_hard: Parameter identifiability, extrapolation and physically defensible model structure.
tasks.human_edge: Hydrologists test whether numerical agreement represents the actual system.
tasks.altitude: Make model preparation more reproducible without automating scientific acceptance.

evidence.claim: Native modelling configurations and input schemas may reduce repeated preparation; no hydrologic development-time result is supplied.

assumptions: Covers model development through local validation and save; no operational water-control deployment or forecast issuance is implied.

Hydrologist produces input variable, unit, datum, spatial reference, time basis and provenance in s3, and parameter and scenario definitions in s4; capture and judgement time remain priced. Incompatible layers or absent metadata require manual reconstruction.
OTHER means the existing hydrologic modelling application; native configuration and templates come before custom AI code generation.
s5 counts the existing human launch and run inspection, not unattended compute time; existing computation earns no saving.
Same-system save s7 stays fully retained without self-approval.
unknowns: Input layer compatibility and availability of reusable model configurations
research_questions: Which configuration fields are genuinely repeated across comparable catchments?

incremental.description: Maintain input schemas and regression-check configuration templates

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=87, gross=13, upkeep=4, central net=9 E1. Low: catchment layers have incompatible resolution and datums, so template reuse is largely lost, retaining 96 hours plus upkeep for zero net. High: aligned observations permit input reuse but a new process representation still needs bespoke configuration, retaining 91 hours plus upkeep for 5 net.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Assign and communicate technical work, supervise staff and record follow-up.

steps.what: Retrieve current professional and technical staff work status
Assign work based on staff competence, research priorities and conditions
Write staff assignments, task requirements and planned dates
Check and communicate assignments and requirements to technical staff
Supervise staff work and resolve emerging technical problems
Assess research work quality and determine needed corrections
Record work progress, concerns and follow-up actions
Check and send the final work follow-up to staff

tasks.design: Configure a current-work view and assignment and follow-up fields in {PROJECT}. Assignment decisions, staff briefing, direct supervision and quality judgement remain distinct; final follow-up is checked and sent through {EMAIL}.
tasks.previous_blocker: Status retrieval and repeated assignment formatting consume supervisory time.
tasks.enabler_now: Native project views and record templates can reduce those clerical portions.
tasks.still_hard: Staff capability, field conditions and technical coaching.
tasks.human_edge: A supervisor spots emerging problems and adapts guidance to the person.
tasks.altitude: Reduce record handling around hands-on technical leadership.

reach.learn: Keep assignments and their communication separate

evidence.claim: Native work views and assignment templates can reduce repeated record handling, with no local measured saving.

assumptions: Includes assignment decision, written assignment, briefing, supervision, quality assessment, follow-up record and send.

Hydrologist captures assignee, work requirement, date, status and concern in s3 and s7; capture is retained. Staff status comes from existing project updates; absent information is clarified manually in s5.
Native views and templates first; no automatic allocation, employee scoring or machine notifications are added.
Ordinary record saves are included in retained entry time without self-approval.
unknowns: Currency of project status and current record templates
research_questions: How much assignment writing is repeatable versus case-specific technical instruction?

incremental.description: Maintain project views and assignment fields

approvals.approved_version: Exact assignment, staff member, requirements and dates being communicated; changed instructions require another check.
Exact follow-up content, corrections and staff recipients; changed content or recipients require another send check.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=94.5, gross=5.5, upkeep=1.5, central net=4 E1. Low: fast-changing field assignments require bespoke instructions and stale status needs direct clarification, retaining 98.5 hours plus upkeep for zero net. High: stable recurring technician assignments fit some fields while scientific guidance remains bespoke, retaining 96.5 hours plus upkeep for 2 net.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Retain scientific and supervisory judgement while improving reproducible records and outputs.
reach: Coordinate measurement metadata with technicians and research interpretation with environmental scientists
role.ambitious_version: A hydrologist with more time for defensible field interpretation, model validation and staff guidance.
